description:
Planning ID: G11-S07-R1
Source: G11-S07 Release Readiness Review

The jido_mcp git dependency transitively requires anubis_mcp, jido, and zoi from Hex. These packages exist in the local cache but Mix cannot verify them without network access. This blocks format checks and tests for jido_connect_mcp in offline environments.

Fix options:
- Pin jido_mcp as a Hex dependency (once published)
- Mirror the git dep's transitive Hex deps explicitly in jido_connect_mcp mix.exs
title: jido_connect_mcp dep resolution requires network access
